508306.name: Viničné
508306.note: The old website (archiv.vinicne.sk) ends in June 2019; the new website (Webygroup) shows only the 2026 municipal elections' documents on its elections page, and the Internet Archive has no capture of an okrsky notice for this vote (only the commissions' minutes for 2024). No document of this vote found.

508977.name: Sebedín-Bečov
508977.note: The 2025 document (Utvorenie volebných okrskov, 28.01.2025, https://www.sebedinbecov.sk/download_file_f.php?id=2176552) forms only one okrsok: 'Okrsok č.1 Sebedín – Bečov časť Sebedín' (the by-election was only in obvod 1 Sebedín); the input expects 2 okrsky, so it cannot be written as 2 okrsky without guessing. Internet Archive CDX for sebedinbecov.sk returned 504 / timed out on repeated tries.
